# RelayOrb

RelayOrb is a tool control plane for AI agents.

- Website: https://relayorb.com
- API docs: https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/blob/main/docs/API.md
- Architecture: https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/blob/main/docs/ARCH.md
- Demo docs: https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/blob/main/docs/DEMO.md
- Runbook: https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOK.md
- Security: https://github.com/khalidsaidi/relayorb/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md
- OpenAPI: https://relayorb.com/.well-known/openapi.json
- MCP endpoint: https://relayorb.com/mcp

## Related projects
- A2ABench: https://a2abench-api.web.app — Public benchmark for agent Q&A performance.
- Ragmap: https://ragmap-api.web.app — MCP search and RAG-focused server discovery.
- Rootfetch: https://rootfetch.com — DNS delegation intelligence with MCP telemetry.
- Agentability: https://agentability.org — Agent-readiness audit and evidence-backed report publishing.
